name: Rein Siedeln
source:
A succubus who sticks with the Archduke as his secretary. Always seeking revolutionary thoughts and ideas, she has complete belief in Theofrad's words and actions. She supports him not only with political affairs, but also on the battlefield fighting by his side. She also has a figure befitting a succubus, and has caught the fancy of many men.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
